items.control_name: Enforce S3 Block Public Access at Account Level
items.description: The account-level S3 Block Public Access setting must have all 4 flags set to TRUE.
items.current_value: All 4 flags (BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets) = TRUE
items.recommended_value: 100% Account-level S3 Block Public Access = TRUE
items.remediation_notes: Maintain AWS SCP to prevent disabling S3 Block Public Access.

items.control_name: Enforce S3 Bucket Default Encryption with Customer Managed KMS Keys
items.description: All S3 buckets must be encrypted by default using AWS KMS Customer Managed Keys (CMK).
items.current_value: 3 buckets using SSE-S3 default encryption instead of SSE-KMS
items.recommended_value: SSE-KMS with Customer Managed Key for all sensitive buckets
items.remediation_notes: Update default bucket encryption on 'app-log-backup' to use KMS CMK.

items.control_name: Enable EBS Default Encryption at Account Level
items.description: Account-level default EBS volume encryption must be enabled in all active regions.
items.current_value: Enabled in us-east-1 and us-west-2; Disabled in eu-central-1
items.recommended_value: EBS Default Encryption enabled across 100% of regions

items.control_name: Enforce Storage Encryption & Auto-Minor Version Upgrade on RDS
items.description: RDS database instances must use KMS encryption at rest and have automatic minor upgrades enabled.
items.current_value: Encrypted with KMS = True on 100% of RDS instances
items.remediation_notes: Regularly audit database parameter groups for enforce_ssl = 1.
